```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
river_data <- read.csv("A8_baltic_DIN.csv", header=FALSE, skip=1)
drain_a <- log(river_data$V2)
pop <- log(river_data$V3)
dens <- log(river_data$V6)
farm_a <- log(river_data$V12+1)
water_runoff <- river_data$V17
pig_pop <- log(river_data$V18+1)
cow_pop <- log(river_data$V19+1)
WC_per <- river_data$V20
country <- river_data$V21
N <- log(river_data$V22)
```

```{r}
full_model <- lm(N ~ drain_a + pop + dens + + farm_a
                   + water_runoff + pig_pop + cow_pop + WC_per)
null_model <- lm(N ~ 1, data = river_data)
final_model <- step(null_model, scope = list(lower = formula(null_model), upper = formula(full_model)), direction = "both")
summary(final_model)
plot(final_model)
```
